decision: Approve the exact selected historical source facts for existing-candidate review and promotion. Preserve every held candidate unchanged.
scope: 355 existing annual candidates for AAPL/AMZN/GOOG/GOOGL/MSFT/NVDA; selected three-year histories only, not full statement/note or valuation certification.

MSFT_FY2024.basis: Official annual report tables 18, 43 and 53 have explicit June 30 2024 columns and million-scale dollar amounts. Rows distinguish balance-sheet cash, current/noncurrent carrying debt and operating lease liabilities. Matching SEC candidate units are USD; original HTML omits inline-XBRL tags.

interest_expense_comparatives.basis: The older companyfacts InterestExpense concepts and newer report InterestExpenseNonoperating comparatives have identical values, currencies and annual dates. Accept the specifically reported interest-expense line, not an assertion that it includes all borrowing or lease costs.

explicit_zeros.basis: Five original selected inline facts use ixt:fixed-zero with the matching concept, unit and period. These are source-encoded zeros, not assumptions about blank cells.

accounting_treatment: Keep balance-sheet cash distinct from cash-flow closing cash including restricted cash. No valuation-available-cash amount is approved.

Basic/diluted shares are historical issuer weighted averages. They do not establish shares outstanding on a valuation date. GOOG and GOOGL retain distinct company records and the shared issuer basis; do not sum class diluted denominators.
Cash capex excludes noncash lease additions; do not substitute broad depreciation or combined PPE/intangible purchases for a narrower metric. Unselected Amazon depreciation remains pending.
Keep commercial paper, current/noncurrent term debt, operating leases and finance leases separate. Avoid adding a total to its components. Complete valuation financing-claim coverage remains open.
Cash dividends and buybacks retain their cash-flow definitions and positive outflow magnitude convention. Apple dividends include dividend equivalents, separate from declared amounts.

Reported historical tax expense and effective tax rates are not forecast or marginal tax assumptions. Unsupported NCI, preferred stock, cross-holdings, net borrowing and working-capital changes stay missing.

Amazon face debt of USD67.182bn/58.000bn/68.836bn differs from carrying debt of USD66.808bn/57.640bn/68.396bn for FY2023/2024/2025. Keep those definitions separate and hold the three generic total-debt candidates; do not overwrite source face values.

Alphabet FY2025 reports operating lease total USD15.954bn but current USD3.209bn plus noncurrent USD12.744bn equals USD15.953bn. Preserve the USD1m difference without asserting an unproven rounding explanation; withhold the total from promotion.
Alphabet FY2023 debt has a changed comparative concept including capital-lease wording. Hold those two ticker records until financing-claim scope is reconciled.
application_requirements: Recheck exact candidate values, units, timestamps, periods and source payload hashes before writes.
Use supported candidate review/promotion with current versions, retain source revisions and Processing Runs.
No saved valuation, forecast, portfolio, prior reviewed history or source payload changes.
Verify final metrics, exact report dates, normalized missing-input behavior and unrelated table/record fingerprints.
